purpose: Explicit targeted Max revision only: author and reader remain Plus with 16,384 thinking plus 49,152 answer tokens; reviser uses Max 32,768 thinking plus 65,536 answer tokens. Paid reader_revision requires --allow-max before any reader charge. No automatic Max fallback. Capacities are not length targets.
